title: 副业不是一概禁止：区分偶尔演讲与长期巡回
topic: 副业不是一概禁止：区分偶尔演讲与长期巡回

source.title: A Note About Moonlighting — OK and Not OK examples
source.section: Definition, OK, and Not OK examples
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课展示 37signals《A Note About Moonlighting》的定义、OK 示例和 Not OK 示例。练习比较偶尔的一次演讲与需要多日、每年多次旅行的固定巡回演讲；一次演讲若需要多日出行，可以使用个人年假覆盖旅行时间。行业活动与演讲者为虚构情境。
paragraphs: Moonlighting means working other professional, paid jobs outside of your work at 37signals. It’s not a black and white topic. There are one-time gigs, other pursuits, or opportunities that help you grow and make life interesting. We want to support that. But we want to make sure professional endeavors outside of 37signals don’t create conflicts of interest or affect your time, dedication, or performance at 37signals. So it’s a delicate balance.
With that in mind, here are some examples of what we’d consider OK and what we would consider a conflict of interest and not OK:
An occasional side gig, free or paid, for someone you know. For example, if you want to work on a friend’s website, or a design or writing project for something you’re involved with, that’s fine.

An occasional speaking gig, free or paid. Someone’s going to pay you to give a talk somewhere? That’s fine as long as it doesn’t involve multiple days off for travel (unless you use your own personal vacation time against this travel time).

A side business that’s different from your day job, as long as the commitment is only a few hours a week. If you come to work exhausted because you’re trying to start a full-time business on the side, it’s going to impact your performance here.

Serve as an advisor for another company, or be on a board, as long as there’s no conflict of interest. The time commitment must be under a few hours a month. And if there’s a scheduling conflict, 37signals gets priority.

Do volunteer or occasional pro-bono work for a cause you’re actively involved with. A little work here and there is fine, but, for example, becoming an organization’s full-time web designer and being on the hook to work during your standard work day, etc, would not be OK.

You can’t work full time or part time for another company in our industry. If you’re unclear about what our industry is, and you have a specific situation you’d like to talk about, ping Jason or David.
Go out on a regular speaking circuit tour which is going to require multiple days of travel multiple times a year. That’s too disruptive to our own work schedule and to your fellow teammates.
Consult for other companies in our industry where there may be a conflict of interest (a competitor, a product tangentially related to 37signals, etc).

Be aggressive in marketing your availability for side work. If something comes to you through a friend or some connection, fine, but aggressively promoting something on the side will ultimately result in a conflict of interest here at work.

Take on anything outside of work that’ll pull attention from work. For example, if you wanted to launch an app, but the app requires providing timely customer support to people who use the app, that’s going to eat into your day here at work. That would ultimately be a problem.
translations: Moonlighting 指在 37signals 的工作之外从事其他有偿专业工作。这不是一个非黑即白的问题。有些是一次性工作、其他追求或能让你成长、让生活更有趣的机会；我们愿意支持。但公司也要确保外部工作不会造成利益冲突，也不会影响你在 37signals 的时间投入、工作专注或表现，因此需要谨慎平衡。
基于这些考虑，下面列出一些我们认为可以接受，以及可能构成利益冲突、不可以接受的情况。
偶尔为熟人做一项副业，无论免费还是有偿，都可以。例如帮朋友做网站，或为自己参与的项目做设计、写作。
偶尔受邀演讲，无论有偿还是无偿，都可以；前提是不会因为出行而请多天假，除非你用自己的个人年假覆盖这些旅行时间。
经营与本职工作不同的副业也可以，但每周投入只能有几个小时。如果为了在业余时间经营全职规模的生意而疲惫上班，就会影响你在这里的表现。
可以担任另一家公司的顾问或董事会成员，但不能有利益冲突；每月投入必须少于几个小时。如果时间安排冲突，应优先 37signals 的工作。
可以为你积极参与的公益事业做志愿服务或偶尔无偿工作。偶尔帮忙没问题；但如果成了某个组织的全职网页设计师，需要在标准工作时间随时提供服务，就不可以。
不能同时为本行业的另一家公司做全职或兼职工作。如果不确定什么算本行业，可以就具体情况联系 Jason 或 David 讨论。
不能定期参加需要每年多次、多日出行的演讲巡回。这会过度打乱公司工作安排和同事的工作。
不能为本行业的其他公司提供可能产生利益冲突的咨询服务，例如竞争对手，或与 37signals 产品相邻的产品公司。
不能积极营销自己承接副业的时间。如果机会来自朋友或熟人介绍则可以；但积极对外推广副业最终会与本职工作产生冲突。
不能承接会分散工作注意力的外部工作。例如，开发一款需要及时为用户提供客服支持的应用，会占用你在这里的工作时间，最终就会成为问题。

notes.phrase: not a black and white topic
notes.meaning: 不是一个非黑即白的问题
notes.explain: 手册没有把所有副业一律允许或一律禁止，而是根据具体工作类型、冲突、时间投入和表现判断。
notes.example: Whether an outside project is okay is not a black and white topic.

notes.explain: 一次性的有偿或无偿演讲可以接受，但需要关注出行是否占用多个工作日。
notes.example: An occasional speaking gig can be fine if it does not require multiple days off.

notes.explain: 若演讲出行需要多个工作日，可以用自己的个人年假覆盖这些天。
notes.example: Use your own personal vacation time for multiple days off for travel.

notes.explain: 来源认为每年多次、多日出行的固定巡回会过度打乱工作安排。
notes.example: A regular speaking circuit tour can disrupt the team’s work schedule.

scenario.title: Comparing an occasional speaking invitation with a regular tour
english: A colleague has been invited to give one paid talk that requires a few days of travel.
They can use personal vacation time for the travel days, but they are also considering a regular speaking tour with repeated trips every year.
You explain how the handbook treats an occasional talk differently from a recurring multi-day tour.
chinese: 一位同事受邀做一次有偿演讲，需要出行几天。
他们可以用个人年假覆盖出行日，但也在考虑每年反复出行的固定巡回演讲。
你说明手册如何区分偶尔一次的演讲和反复多日出行的巡回活动。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事受邀做一次有偿演讲，需要多天出行；他也在考虑每年多次、多日出行的固定巡回演讲。请用英文说明偶尔演讲的条件，以及固定巡回为什么不同。
firstAttempt.sample: An occasional speaking gig can be fine. If it involves multiple days off for travel, you can use your own personal vacation time for those days. A regular speaking circuit with repeated multi-day trips would be too disruptive to our work schedule.
firstAttempt.rationale: 要区分偶尔演讲与定期巡回；前者可接受的条件是多日出行用个人年假覆盖，后者因反复旅行会打乱工作安排而不可接受。

words.meaning: 本职工作之外的有偿专业工作；副业
words.example: The handbook says moonlighting is not a black-and-white topic.
words.translation: 手册说，副业不是一个非黑即白的问题。
words.note: 是否可接受要结合具体工作类型及其对本职的影响判断。

words.example: An occasional speaking gig can be fine.
words.translation: 偶尔受邀演讲可以接受。
words.note: 与 regular speaking circuit（定期演讲巡回）形成对照。

words.collocation: take multiple days off for travel
words.example: The trip should not require multiple days off unless you use personal vacation time.
words.translation: 除非使用个人年假，否则出行不应占用多个工作日。
words.note: 来源针对偶尔演讲的多日旅行条件。

words.example: A regular speaking circuit involving repeated travel is too disruptive.
words.translation: 需要反复出行的定期巡回演讲会过度打乱工作。
words.note: 手册把每年多次、多日出行的固定巡回列为不可以接受。

words.example: Use your own vacation time for the travel days.
words.translation: 用自己的年假覆盖出行日。
words.note: 这是来源对偶尔演讲需要多日旅行所给的条件。

words.meaning: 造成干扰的；打乱安排的
words.collocation: be disruptive to a work schedule
words.example: Repeated multi-day trips can be disruptive to the team’s work schedule.
words.translation: 反复多日出行会打乱团队工作安排。
words.note: 形容安排对日常工作或同事造成明显干扰。

structure.original: That’s fine as long as it doesn’t involve multiple days off for travel (unless you use your own personal vacation time against this travel time).
analysis: That’s fine 是主句，表示偶尔演讲可以接受。
as long as 引导条件从句，说明前提是不会因旅行请多天假。
括号中的 unless 引出例外：如果用自己的个人年假覆盖旅行时间，则另当别论。
structure.transfer: An occasional side business may be fine if it is different from your day job and takes only a few hours a week. A full-time commitment that leaves you exhausted could affect your performance.

rewrite.bad: You can take every speaking invitation, even if it means traveling for several workdays several times a year.
rewrite.good: An occasional speaking gig can be fine. If it involves multiple days off for travel, you can use your own personal vacation time for those days. A regular speaking circuit with repeated multi-day trips would be too disruptive to our work schedule.
rewrite.translation: 偶尔受邀演讲可以接受。如果需要多天出行，可以用自己的个人年假覆盖这些日子。需要反复多日出行的定期巡回演讲会过度打乱工作安排。
rewrite.pattern: An occasional [activity] can be fine if [condition]. A regular [commitment] that [repeatedly affects work] can be too disruptive.

cloze.prompt: An occasional speaking gig can be ___ if the travel does not disrupt work.
cloze.why: fine 在此表示可以接受，但仍要满足出行不影响工作的条件。

cloze.prompt: Use your own personal vacation time for multiple days off for ___.
cloze.why: 来源允许用个人年假覆盖演讲所需的多日旅行。

cloze.prompt: A regular speaking circuit can be too ___ to the team’s schedule.
cloze.why: 反复多日旅行会打乱公司和同事的工作安排。

dictation.text: An occasional speaking gig, free or paid.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 偶尔的演讲机会
dictation.why: 听出 occasional 与 free or paid，留意手册允许的是偶尔演讲。

dictation.text: That’s fine as long as it doesn’t involve multiple days off for travel.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 多日出行条件
dictation.why: as long as 引出可接受的条件；听清 multiple days off for travel。

apply.prompt: 同事的演讲需要多天出行。请说明何时可以接受，以及应如何处理旅行日。
apply.sample: An occasional speaking gig can be fine. If it involves multiple days off for travel, use your own personal vacation time for those days.

translationPractice.prompt: 偶尔受邀演讲可以接受。
translationPractice.answer: An occasional speaking gig can be fine.
translationPractice.why: occasional 表示偶尔发生；can be fine 保留“可以接受”的条件语气。

translationPractice.prompt: 如果需要多天出行，就用自己的年假覆盖这些日子。
translationPractice.answer: If the trip requires multiple days off, use your own vacation time for those travel days.
translationPractice.why: multiple days off 对应多天请假；personal vacation time 是来源给出的出行安排。

translationPractice.prompt: 需要反复多日出行的定期巡回演讲会打乱工作安排。
translationPractice.answer: A regular speaking circuit with repeated multi-day trips can disrupt our work schedule.
translationPractice.why: regular 和 repeated multi-day trips 说明这是定期巡回，而非偶尔演讲。

choice.prompt: 同事既有一次性的有偿演讲邀请，也在考虑每年多次、多日出行的固定巡回。请选择最符合手册的回复。
options: Both are always fine as long as the talks happen outside normal work hours.
An occasional speaking gig can be fine; use personal vacation time if it requires multiple days off for travel. A regular circuit with repeated multi-day trips is too disruptive to the work schedule.
Any paid speaking is prohibited, even if it is occasional and does not affect work.
choice.why: 正确项区分偶尔演讲和定期巡回，也保留了多日旅行可用个人年假的例外。

output.prompt: 同事想开一项与本职工作不同的副业，但担心时间投入过多。请用英文说明手册允许的时间范围，以及全职规模的副业可能造成什么影响。
output.sample: A side business that is different from your day job can be fine if the commitment is only a few hours a week. A full-time side business that leaves you exhausted could affect your performance at work.
check: 是否说明副业应与本职工作不同？
是否说明每周只能投入几个小时？
是否指出疲惫上班会影响工作表现？
